command:
# G1 (#17): make oracle DB=all on Graviton (Linux aarch64), the canonical oracle platform, for
# both pinned databases (Viral and Standard-8).
# Code: the launch commit (the short sha ending AK2_RUN_ID), cloned from GitHub. Databases and
# reads: the in-region copies declared in AK2_DATASETS (`make stage-db DB=viral|standard8`,
# `make stage-reads`), each file checked against its sha256 before use, so the run depends on
# neither genome-idx (us-east-1) nor ENA. Not a benchmark: no cold rung, no drop_caches.
# Every setup step fails fast; the oracle's output streams into the run log; push failures count
# into the exit status.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
U=${1#s3://}; B=${U%%/*}; K=${U#*/}; DATA=${K%/*/*}
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
hex64() { [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; }

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git gcc-c++ make zlib-devel perl jq bzip2 gzip tar findutils diffutils > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 \
  || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
ak2_say "dnf ok ($(gcc --version | head -1); $(gzip --version | head -1))"
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA head=$(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-arm64.tar.gz" -o "$W/go.tgz" || fail "Go download failed"
tar -xzf "$W/go.tgz" -C "$W" || fail "Go unpack failed"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
go version > /dev/null || fail "no Go toolchain"
ak2_say "go: $(go version)"

# check_obj FILE KEY: FILE is non-empty and its sha256 equals the object's sha256 metadata.
check_obj() {
  local f=$1 key=$2 s want got
  s=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  # aws s3 cp: one GET below the 8 MiB multipart threshold, else 8 MiB ranged GETs.
  ak2_req GetObject $(( s < 8388608 ? 1 : (s + 8388607) / 8388608 )) "$B"
  want=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$key" --query Metadata.sha256 --output text)
  ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
  got=$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  ak2_say "staged $key bytes=$s sha256=$got object-metadata=$want"
  hex64 "$want" && hex64 "$got" && [ "$got" = "$want" ] && [ "$s" -gt 0 ] \
    || fail "$key does not match its sha256 metadata (or is empty)"
}

ak2_phase fetch
for NAME in k2_viral_20260626 k2_standard_08_GB_20260626; do
  P="$DATA/$NAME"; DB="$W/repo/.cache/db/$NAME"
  mkdir -p "$DB"
  ak2_stage "s3://$B/$P/" "$DB/" || fail "stage of $NAME failed"
  ak2_req ListObjectsV2 1 "$B"
  for f in hash.k2d opts.k2d taxo.k2d SOURCE; do check_obj "$DB/$f" "$P/$f"; done
  # Only a verified copy is marked as staged.
  echo "staged_from s3://$B/$P/ $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> "$DB/SOURCE"
  ak2_push "$DB/SOURCE" "db-SOURCE-$NAME" || fail "push of db-SOURCE-$NAME failed"
done
RD="$W/repo/.cache/reads"; mkdir -p "$RD"
# Only the declared read files, one ak2_stage each (the prefix holds more than this run uses).
for r in SRR062634 ERR478965 SRR28305653; do
  for f in "${r}_200000.SOURCE" "${r}_200000_1.fq" "${r}_200000_2.fq" "${r}_200000_1.fq.gz" "${r}_200000_2.fq.gz"; do
    ak2_stage "s3://$B/$DATA/reads/$f" "$RD/$f" || fail "stage of reads/$f failed"
    check_obj "$RD/$f" "$DATA/reads/$f"
  done
  # The plain FASTQs, and what their gzip copies decompress to, must match the sha256 their
  # SOURCE recorded when ENA served them.
  for m in 1 2; do
    f="${r}_200000_$m.fq"
    h=$(sha256sum "$RD/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    grep -qx "sha256 $h $f" "$RD/${r}_200000.SOURCE" || fail "$f does not match ${r}_200000.SOURCE"
    h=$(gzip -dc "$RD/$f.gz" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
    grep -qx "sha256 $h $f" "$RD/${r}_200000.SOURCE" || fail "$f.gz does not decompress to the $f in ${r}_200000.SOURCE"
  done
  ak2_say "reads $r verified against SOURCE"
done

ak2_phase build
cd "$W/repo" || fail "no repo"
scripts/oracle-build.sh > "$W/oracle-build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/oracle-build.out"; fail "oracle-build failed"; }
ak2_say "oracle-build ok: $(tail -1 "$W/oracle-build.out")"
make build > "$W/make-build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/make-build.out"; fail "make build failed"; }
ak2_say "make build ok"

ak2_phase oracle
# Streamed into the run log as it runs (the preamble tees stdout).
make oracle DB=all ORACLE_THREADS=8 2>&1 | tee "$W/oracle.out"
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
ak2_say "make oracle DB=all rc=$RC"

ak2_phase push
# Only the result directories this run created (make oracle prints "results: <dir>").
PF=0
DIRS=$(sed -n 's/^results: //p' "$W/oracle.out")
[ -n "$DIRS" ] || { ak2_say "ERROR: make oracle reported no results directory"; PF=$((PF + 1)); }
for d in $DIRS; do
  for f in "$d"/*; do ak2_push "$f" "$(basename "$d")/$(basename "$f")" || PF=$((PF + 1)); done
done
ak2_push "$W/oracle.out" oracle.out || PF=$((PF + 1))
ak2_say "G1 oracle done rc=$RC push_failures=$PF"
[ "$RC" != 0 ] && exit "$RC"
[ "$PF" = 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
